metadata.name: GetAccountDocuments
metadata.description: This API is Used to Get the Document Details of the Account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXX Example:123654789632 Condition:At least one of AccountNumber/AdminNumber/AccountID is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AccountID
request_fields.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Valid Values: 0-9 Example:12345 Condition:At least one of AccountNumber/AdminNumber/AccountID is required.

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values: 0-9 Example:12345 Condition:At least one of AccountNumber/AdminNumber/AccountID is required.

request_fields.name: DisputeCaseID
request_fields.description: Case ID assigned to a Dispute Case. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 23654789

request_fields.name: SKeyList
request_fields.description: System Unique ID, to be Used as Input while Deleting or Updating Account Documents. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 17852

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ListAccountDocument
children.description: Details of Documents available for the Account.

children.name: SUID
children.description: System Unique ID, to be Used as Input while Deleting or Updating Account Documents. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 17852

children.name: DocumentType
children.description: Type of the Document Valid Values: a-z Example: Bankruptcy Paper Allowable Values: 100

children.name: DocumentName
children.description: Name of the Document. Valid Values: a-z, 0-9 Example: abc Allowable Values: 200

children.name: UploadBy
children.description: UserID of the User Created/Uploaded the Document Valid Values: a-z Example: abc Allowable Values: 100

children.name: AccountID
children.description: Account ID represents Unique Identity of Account (CoreCard Bsegment Entitity, i.e., the Account ID of program card account). Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 12345

children.name: AccountNumber
children.description: Account number of cardholder. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 100785265566444 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: MerchantID
children.description: Id of the Merchant Under which the Account is Created. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 147852

children.name: CreatedDate
children.description: The Date and Time if New Document Uploaded Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/07/2020 11:05:05

children.name: UpdateDate
children.description: The Date and Time If Existing Document Updated Valid Values: 0-9 Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example: 01/07/2020 11:05:05

children.name: IsDeleted
children.description: Indicates if the Document is deleted or Not. Valid Values: True,False Example: False

children.name: BinaryData
children.description: Depending on the 'SUID' system will convert the Document data into binary data and populate in this Tag.

children.name: DisputeDocumentCategory
children.description: Category of Dispute Document to be Upload
